Transient storage written in one item is visible within it and reset for the next item.
Accounts and slots warmed by one item are cold again in the next: BALANCE then SLOAD cost cold, then warm.

Each item snapshots original storage: a slot committed by the previous item is clean and cold (5000 gas), not dirty.
